item.description:
## Changes
- The Dashboard is now just your calls: the Overview numbers and the calls-by-app list moved to Settings, in a new Statistics section. - Import…, Open Ahoy Folder and Re-export all moved into the Dashboard's new Other menu. You can still import by dropping audio files on the window or with Open With in Finder. - The period list shows in narrower windows too, now that the Dashboard has more room. - If you start scrolling while a period jump is still settling, the feed no longer snaps back to that period's heading. - The Statistics numbers update right away after you change how long audio is kept.

## Changes
- Clicking a period in the Dashboard's period list now lands on that period's heading even in a long library, including older months and years. - After you click a period, scrolling with a mouse wheel or trackpad moves the feed freely again instead of stalling near that period's heading. - The period list keeps showing the right period while you scroll through a long month.

## Changes
- The Dashboard's period list and the Settings category list now sit on the right. The Dashboard's Overview and By app panels moved to the left. - A new call's day heading no longer opens above the visible part of the Dashboard after you have scrolled or jumped to a period. - After you click a period, any scroll you make yourself hands the highlight back to the period you are looking at. - With a non-Gregorian calendar (for example Japanese), older years in the period list show their proper year names. - The Dashboard does less work while you search and when it redraws dates.
